min_gpa_host.notes: No minimum incoming exchange GPA is published on https://www.roanoke.edu/inside/a-z_index/international_education/information_for_prospective_students.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Proof of English proficiency is required if the primary language of instruction at the home institution is not English; accepted tests include TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, CEFR, Pearson's English Test, or Cambridge Exams (exact numeric cutoffs and RHET 1020 equivalency are not stated; AUC is an English-medium institution).

host_language_requirement.value: English (proficiency demonstration required unless home institution instruction is primarily in English).

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: New students move in Aug 22; Evening classes begin Aug 25 / Day classes begin Aug 26; Fall Break Oct 15-18; Thanksgiving Break Nov 23-29; Last day of classes Dec 4; Final Exams Dec 7-11, 2026.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027: Residence halls open Jan 5-6; Classes begin Jan 7; Spring Break Mar 1-7; Last day of classes Apr 19; Final Exams Apr 20-26; Commencement May 1, 2027 (optional May Intensive Learning Term May 10-28, 2027).

tuition_model.notes: Tuition-waiver wording is not explicitly stated on https://www.roanoke.edu/inside/a-z_index/international_education/information_for_prospective_students (lists American University in Cairo as partner institution; regular 2026-27 non-exchange UG tuition list price is $38,420/yr).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived from Roanoke College 2026-27 on-campus Housing + 19-Meal Plan rates divided across a 5-month semester: Standard double housing ($7,614/yr = $3,807/sem) to single/apartment rooms up to $9,786/yr ($4,893/sem), plus 19-Meal Plan ($8,732/yr = $4,366/sem) = $8,173-$9,259/semester ($1,634.60-$1,851.80/month). Excludes $1,580/yr health insurance and books/personal expenses.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 1 USD = 1.0 USD on 2026-11-15 (native USD); 5-month semester midpoint of 2026-27 on-campus housing ($3,807 double to $4,893 Maroon Village single/apt per sem) + 19-Meal Plan ($4,366/sem) = $8,173-$9,259/semester (midpoint $8,716.00/semester). Excludes $1,580/yr international health insurance and books/personal costs.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: 2026-2027 mandatory international student health insurance plan is $1,580/year (official ISEP exchange students are exempt from this institutional insurance charge). Regular residential student/technology fees range $2,208-$3,788/year.

housing_availability.notes: Residential campus with residence halls including Global Village (Chalmers Hall); exchange housing guarantee status is not explicitly stated.

housing_notes.value: 2026-27 on-campus standard double room is $7,614/yr ($3,807/sem), single rooms up to $8,668-$9,786/yr; required 19-meal plan $8,732/yr ($4,366/sem). International and domestic students may reside in the Global Village community (Chalmers Hall).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: International students coordinate visa sponsorship via International Student Services (I-20 for F-1 status or DS-2019 for J-1 sponsored exchange students such as ISEP).

credit_system_and_load.value: Course unit system: 1 unit = 4 semester hours. Minimum full-time load is 3 units (12 credits); normal full-time load is 4 or 5 units/semester (16-20 credits; overload tuition applies above 5 units).

city_tier.notes: Roanoke College is located in Salem, Virginia (Roanoke Valley); no explicit city-tier classification appears on verified roanoke.edu pages.

campus_type.notes: Residential historic campus in Salem, Virginia; explicit schema campus_type label omitted without ambiguous third-party sources.

international_support_services.value: Incoming partner exchange applications handled directly by Dr. Michael Hancock-Parmer (mhancock@roanoke.edu); International Student Services (Morehead Hall) and Office of Global Engagement (Lucas Hall) handle F-1/J-1 advising and Global Village housing.

nomination_deadlines.notes: Incoming exchange deadlines are coordinated via partner offices / mhancock@roanoke.edu (standard non-exchange international admission deadlines are Nov 30 for Spring and Apr 15 for Fall).
